prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED DEEP INDIGO flat color field — think #392E7C,
the color of hidden retention, enclosed meaning, and private memory on
a semantic map. The hue must read as DEEP INDIGO, not black, not ocean
blue, not silence violet. Clearly distinct from the brighter cobalt
breakaway tile. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this
one deep-indigo color corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border,
NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO cave mouth, NO
figures, NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation within
the same indigo hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an
illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Saturated flat ink wash filling the entire frame edge-to-edge in deep indigo, comic-map terrain tile register, pure region-fill swatch with faint brushed paint-texture variation within the same hue.

subjects.description: Deep indigo flat wash, full 1024x1024 coverage, subtle paint-texture ripple within unified hue, no symbols or forms
